title: Can an ‘Anarcho-Capitalist’ President Save Argentina’s Economy?

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店做 DJ 时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带上 300 件最珍贵的藏品去工作，把 DJ 台变成一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Argentina, a poster child for economic dysfunction, is again in the midst of an acute crisis.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷，这个经济功能失调的典型代表，再次陷入了严重的危机之中。

sentences.en: Last month, fed up with liberal fixes, Argentines voted for the candidate promising to blow it all up.
sentences.zh: 上个月，厌倦了自由派修补措施的阿根廷人投票选出了一位承诺要彻底推翻这一切的候选人。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Jack Nickas on Javier Millet, the right-wing populist now taking office in Argentina, and his radical plan to remake the country's economy.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事杰克·尼卡斯将讲述哈维尔·米莱，这位刚刚在阿根廷上台的右翼民粹主义者，以及他重塑国家经济的激进计划。

sentences.en: It's Monday, December 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 12 月 11 日，星期一。

sentences.en: Jack, it's nice to see you again.
sentences.zh: 杰克，很高兴再次见到你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: So, we are talking today about Argentina and its new president, Javier Millet.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们今天讨论的是阿根廷及其新任总统哈维尔·米莱。

sentences.en: He was inaugurated yesterday, and he's a pretty flamboyant and colorful populist, kind of styled in the vein of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他昨天刚就职，是一位相当张扬且色彩鲜明的民粹主义者，风格有点像唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So, tell me about this new president.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我说说这位新总统吧。

sentences.en: Well, this was really one of the most surprising elections in Argentina's history.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实是阿根廷历史上最令人惊讶的选举之一。

sentences.en: And from the start, the national conversation was dominated by Javier Millet.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，全国的讨论焦点就被哈维尔·米莱所主导。

sentences.en: Soy Javier Millet.
sentences.zh: 我是哈维尔·米莱。

sentences.en: Soy economista, liberal libertario.
sentences.zh: 我是经济学家，自由意志主义者。

sentences.en: He spent years working as an economist and teaching economics, then was elected as a freshman congressman, who really didn't show up to Congress much,
sentences.zh: 他做了多年的经济学家和经济学教师，后来当选为国会众议员，但他其实很少去国会，

sentences.en: but really became known to Argentines for many years of TV punch-and-try.
sentences.zh: 但他真正为阿根廷人所熟知，是因为多年来在电视上的唇枪舌剑。

sentences.en: He used to be brought on to these cable news talk shows to be the token conservative voice in a country that has, in recent years, been pretty left-leaning.
sentences.zh: 他过去常被请到这些有线电视谈话节目中，作为这个近年来相当左倾的国家里，那个标志性的保守派声音。

sentences.en: And he really stood out for a combative style and opinions that are really outside of the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 他因好斗的风格和非常规的观点而脱颖而出。

sentences.en: So, for example, he called the Pope a communist and the embodiment of evil.
sentences.zh: 例如，他称教皇是共产主义者，是邪恶的化身。

sentences.en: El Papa impulsa el comunismo.
sentences.zh: 教皇在推动共产主义。

sentences.en: And bear in mind, the Pope is Argentine and a huge figure in the country.
sentences.zh: 请记住，教皇是阿根廷人，在阿根廷有着巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: So, this was really controversial.
sentences.zh: 所以，这引起了极大的争议。

sentences.en: Empecemos por la verdad.
sentences.zh: 让我们从事实开始说起。

sentences.en: No fueron 30.000 los desaparecidos.
sentences.zh: 失踪人数并非 3 万人。

sentences.en: And he's also suggested that the left has greatly exaggerated the number of disappearances or murders that occurred during the bloody military dictatorship in the 1970s and 1980s.
sentences.zh: 他还暗示左派大大夸大了 20 世纪 70 年代和 80 年代血腥军事独裁统治期间发生的失踪或谋杀人数。

sentences.en: And that struck a lot of people as a troubling sympathy for the country's authoritarian paSt.
sentences.zh: 这让许多人感到不安，认为他是在同情这个国家的威权过去。

sentences.en: He's argued that the right is aesthetically and intellectually superior than the left.
sentences.zh: 他认为右派在审美和智力上都优于左派。

sentences.en: He has said climate change is a socialist plot.
sentences.zh: 他说气候变化是一个社会主义阴谋。

sentences.en: And in the lead-up to his elections, he was peddling baseless claims of voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 在选举前夕，他还散布毫无根据的选民欺诈指控。

sentences.en: But despite these unusual and, to many, worrisome politics, the thing that you need to understand about Argentina is that politics is really about economics.
sentences.zh: 但尽管有这些不同寻常且在许多人看来令人担忧的政治主张，你需要了解的是，阿根廷的政治核心其实是经济。

sentences.en: And Millet is the candidate promising a sharp break economically.
sentences.zh: 而米莱正是那位承诺在经济上进行彻底决裂的候选人。

sentences.en: Cortar la obra pública, porque todo lo que hacen con obra pública es un robo descarado.
sentences.zh: 削减公共工程，因为他们所做的所有公共工程都是明目张胆的抢劫。

sentences.en: Es un monumento a la corrupción.
sentences.zh: 那是腐败的纪念碑。

sentences.en: Specifically, he's pitching voters on a libertarian overhaul of government.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，他向选民推销的是一种自由意志主义的政府彻底改革。

sentences.en: And libertarian meaning?
sentences.zh: 自由意志主义是什么意思？

sentences.en: Meaning that he wants to essentially kind of get the state to get out of the way.
sentences.zh: 意思是，他本质上想让国家别再碍手碍脚。

sentences.en: Ministerio de Educación.
sentences.zh: 教育部。

sentences.en: Adoctrinamiento.
sentences.zh: 洗脑工具。

sentences.en: Afuera.
sentences.zh: 砍掉。

sentences.en: Ministerio de Obras Públicas.
sentences.zh: 公共工程部。

sentences.en: Afuera.
sentences.zh: 砍掉。

sentences.en: Aunque te resistas.
sentences.zh: 哪怕你反抗也没用。

sentences.en: He's trying to argue that the state is predatory against the average citizen in its policies and taxes, etc.
sentences.zh: 他试图论证，国家在政策和税收等方面对普通公民具有掠夺性。

sentences.en: And these libertarian views would really be a radical departure from what the government and what Argentina has had for decades, essentially.
sentences.zh: 这些自由意志主义观点与政府和阿根廷几十年来所实行的政策相比，将是一个彻底的背离。

sentences.en: And so Millet's election victory showed how desperate voters are for change.
sentences.zh: 因此，米莱的胜选表明选民对变革是多么渴望。

sentences.en: So tell me about that desperation.
sentences.zh: 那么跟我说说那种绝望感吧。

sentences.en: Like, what was it that caused Argentines to elect this political newcomer with these extreme views?
sentences.zh: 是什么导致阿根廷人选出了这位持有极端观点的新人？

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: I think anyone who has been vaguely paying attention to Argentina over the past several decades knows that they've been dealing with an economic crisis after economic crisis for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我想任何过去几十年稍微关注过阿根廷的人都知道，他们长期以来一直在应对一场又一场的经济危机。

sentences.en: And they're currently in one of their worSt.
sentences.zh: 而他们目前正处于最糟糕的时期之一。

sentences.en: And that's saying something for Argentina.
sentences.zh: 这对阿根廷来说可不是小事。

sentences.en: Right now, annual inflation stands at above 140%.
sentences.zh: 目前，年通胀率已超过 140%。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The Argentine peso has completely disintegrated in value.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷比索的价值已经彻底崩塌。

sentences.en: And just more and more Argentines are falling into poverty.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的阿根廷人陷入贫困。

sentences.en: So what does 140% inflation look like?
sentences.zh: 那么 140% 的通胀是什么样子？

sentences.en: Give us a sense of that.
sentences.zh: 给我们描述一下。

sentences.en: Well, it's a situation where the value of the Argentine currency is constantly falling and prices are constantly going up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在这种情况下，阿根廷货币的价值不断下跌，物价不断上涨。

sentences.en: So it's a bit confusing to live in Argentina sometimes.
sentences.zh: 所以生活在阿根廷有时会让人感到困惑。

sentences.en: I'll give you one example.
sentences.zh: 我给你举个例子。

sentences.en: Si tuviera plata, tendría que cerrar el negocio.
sentences.zh: 如果我有现金，我就得关门歇业。

sentences.en: When I was in Buenos Aires recently, I met this owner of a hardware store called Oscar Benitez.
sentences.zh: 我最近在布宜诺斯艾利斯时，遇到了一位名叫奥斯卡·贝尼特斯的五金店老板。

sentences.en: His store is this really lovely little kind of almost tiny walk-in closet in a way, but covered in products.
sentences.zh: 他的店非常可爱，小得像个步入式衣橱，但里面堆满了商品。

sentences.en: Screws and hinges and locks.
sentences.zh: 螺丝、合页和锁具。

sentences.en: But he doesn't know the price really of any of them.
sentences.zh: 但他其实根本不知道其中任何一件东西的价格。

sentences.en: Because of the fact that the peso's value is falling so quickly and prices are rising so quickly,
sentences.zh: 因为比索贬值太快，物价上涨也太快，

sentences.en: and when someone wants to buy something, he has to go to his computer to look at a list that the supplier provides him, which is constantly updating with new prices.
sentences.zh: 当有人想买东西时，他必须去电脑上查看供应商提供的清单，而清单上的价格一直在更新。

sentences.en: So how often does he have to do this?
sentences.zh: 那他多久需要更新一次价格？

sentences.en: He said that those prices were changing at sometimes several times a week.
sentences.zh: 他说这些价格有时一周会变好几次。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And how is he doing personally, his financial?
sentences.zh: 他个人的财务状况如何？

sentences.en: He was depressed and, you know, kind of had a lot of gallows humor about the situation.
sentences.zh: 他很沮丧，你知道，对这种情况有一种苦中作乐的幽默感。

sentences.en: Y guardar pesos es lo mismo que guardar el papel higiénico usado, para que te des una idea.
sentences.zh: 存比索就跟存用过的卫生纸一样，让你有个概念。

sentences.en: I mean, he at one point called the Argentine peso used toilet paper.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他一度把阿根廷比索称为用过的卫生纸。

sentences.en: And as a result, he has tried to find ways to cope.
sentences.zh: 因此，他试图寻找应对的方法。

sentences.en: What does he do when he gets money?
sentences.zh: 他拿到钱后会做什么？

sentences.en: Con lo que vendo, compro.
sentences.zh: 卖了东西，我就去买货。

sentences.en: He buys for it.
sentences.zh: 他用钱去买货。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to hold on to it.
sentences.zh: 他不想持有现金。

sentences.en: No, porque el peso no sirve.
sentences.zh: 不，因为比索没用。

sentences.en: No, porque el peso no sirve.
sentences.zh: 不，因为比索没用。

sentences.en: No sirve.
sentences.zh: 没用。

sentences.en: You know, when he gets pesos, he tries to get rid of them as quickly as possible so they don't lose any more value.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当他拿到比索时，他会尽快花掉，以免它们进一步贬值。

sentences.en: So he either goes and buys more products and supplies, he has way more than he really needs, but he feels they hold value better than the peso, or he buys U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以他要么去买更多的产品和物资，虽然他囤积的远超实际需求，但他觉得这些东西比比索更保值，要么他就去买美元。

sentences.en: dollars.
sentences.zh: 美元。

sentences.en: So he's basically trying to preserve the value of the money that he has by going out and buying dollars.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上是通过去买美元来试图保住他手中钱的价值。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Argentines, for many years now, have flocked to dollar bills to hold their value, to save their money.
sentences.zh: 多年来，阿根廷人一直涌向美元来保值和储蓄。

sentences.en: As a result, more than $200 billion in hard U.S.
sentences.zh: 结果，现在有超过 2000 亿美元的硬通货在阿根廷流通。

sentences.en: currency is now in Argentina.
sentences.zh: 这意味着按人均计算，阿根廷人持有的美元纸币比美国人还多。

sentences.en: And that means that on a per capita basis, Argentines hold more banknotes, U.S.
sentences.zh: 事实上，任何在阿根廷买过房的人都会告诉你，他们几乎肯定是用 100 美元的钞票支付的。

sentences.en: banknotes, than Americans.
sentences.zh: 美元纸币。

sentences.en: And in fact, anybody who has bought a house in Argentina will tell you that they almost certainly bought it in $100 bills.
sentences.zh: 事实上，任何在阿根廷买过房的人都会告诉你，他们几乎肯定是用 100 美元的钞票支付的。

sentences.en: Okay, so Argentines have a lot of American dollars, which is, of course, a bad sign for their economy.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以阿根廷人有很多美元，这当然是他们经济的一个坏信号。

sentences.en: Reminds me a lot of Russia in the 1990s, when also the ruble was just going wild and losing value.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起 20 世纪 90 年代的俄罗斯，当时卢布也陷入疯狂，不断贬值。

sentences.en: People used dollars to buy big, important things.
sentences.zh: 人们用美元购买大型重要商品。

sentences.en: At that time, it was a communist economy going into the global one.
sentences.zh: 那时，是一个共产主义经济体正在融入全球经济。

sentences.en: And what is it here?
sentences.zh: 那这里的情况是什么？

sentences.en: What caused this in Argentina?
sentences.zh: 是什么导致了阿根廷的这种局面？

sentences.en: Well, it's a long story, but the short story is that it's really just decades of deep economic mismanagement.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个漫长的故事，但简而言之，这其实就是几十年来严重的经济管理不善。

sentences.en: A series of left-leaning governments has expanded the social safety net with things like free health care, free universities,
sentences.zh: 一系列左倾政府扩大了社会保障网，提供免费医疗、免费大学等福利，

sentences.en: a dramatic expansion of social programs, deep subsidies for energy and public transportation, big pensions.
sentences.zh: 大幅扩张社会项目，对能源和公共交通进行巨额补贴，发放高额养老金。

sentences.en: And all of that without much economic revenue to pay for it.
sentences.zh: 而所有这些都没有足够的经济收入来支撑。

sentences.en: But to make up for that shortfall, they have drained economic reserves, they have taken out massive international debt, and also just printed more money.
sentences.zh: 为了弥补赤字，他们耗尽了经济储备，背负了巨额国际债务，还不停地印钞。

sentences.en: And that has left the peso much less valuable, and prices skyrocketing.
sentences.zh: 这导致比索大幅贬值，物价飞涨。

sentences.en: Which brings us to Mr. Malay.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了米莱先生。

sentences.en: So, what are the specifics of what he's proposing, Jack?
sentences.zh: 那么，杰克，他提出的具体方案是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, what's his economic plan exactly?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他确切的经济计划是什么？

sentences.en: Well, he wants to take Argentina in a completely different direction.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他想带领阿根廷走上一条完全不同的道路。

sentences.en: So, specifically, he wants to drastically shrink the size of government.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，他想大幅缩减政府规模。

sentences.en: He wants to eliminate 10 of the government's 18 ministries.
sentences.zh: 他想撤销政府 18 个部门中的 10 个。

sentences.en: He has proposed privatizing the state airline, the railroad company, the state oil company,
sentences.zh: 他提议将国有航空公司、铁路公司、国有石油公司私有化，

sentences.en: and really trying to remake the Argentine government and Argentina itself in his libertarian view of the world.
sentences.zh: 并真正试图按照他的自由意志主义世界观来重塑阿根廷政府和阿根廷本身。

sentences.en: And that also means some much more radical ideas.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着一些更激进的想法。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Okay, so Malay is elected.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以米莱当选了。

sentences.en: He has this kind of Hail Mary plan to rescue the country's economy, including slashing all these government ministries and really taking a chainsaw, as he has, on spending.
sentences.zh: 他有一个孤注一掷的计划来拯救国家经济，包括削减所有这些政府部门，并像他所说的那样，真正对开支动用“电锯”。

sentences.en: But there's something you said that's even more radical at the heart of his plan.
sentences.zh: 但你刚才提到，他的计划核心还有更激进的东西。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: So, actually, the central part of his campaign pitch has been what we would call dollarization.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他竞选纲领的核心一直是我们所说的“美元化”。

sentences.en: He essentially wants to use the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他本质上是想使用美元作为阿根廷的本国货币。

sentences.en: dollar as Argentina's national currency.
sentences.zh: 使用美元作为阿根廷的本国货币。

sentences.en: Use the U.S.
sentences.zh: 使用美元。

sentences.en: dollar as Argentina's national currency.
sentences.zh: 作为阿根廷的本国货币。

sentences.en: How would that work?
sentences.zh: 那会怎么运作？

sentences.en: So, basically, his argument is that the Argentine government has shown to be so irresponsible in its management of the currency,
sentences.zh: 基本上，他的论点是阿根廷政府在货币管理上表现得极其不负责任，

sentences.en: and the Argentine peso has become so worthless, you might as well just kill it and use a more stable currency, you know, specifically like the dollar.
sentences.zh: 而阿根廷比索已经变得一文不值，你还不如直接废掉它，改用一种更稳定的货币，你知道，特别是像美元这样的货币。

sentences.en: And he chose the dollar because Argentina is already kind of dollarized.
sentences.zh: 他选择美元是因为阿根廷在某种程度上已经“美元化”了。

sentences.en: I mean, we spoke about how people buy houses with U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们谈到人们如何用美元买房。

sentences.en: dollars.
sentences.zh: 美元。

sentences.en: They stash U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们把美元藏在地板下和床垫里。

sentences.en: dollars under their floorboards and their mattresses.
sentences.zh: 美元。

sentences.en: So, this is a country that is already deeply comfortable with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个已经对美元非常适应，并且已经在大量使用美元的国家。

sentences.en: dollar and is already using a lot of U.S.
sentences.zh: 美元。

sentences.en: dollars.
sentences.zh: 美元。

sentences.en: And so, he basically wants to formalize that.
sentences.zh: 所以，他基本上是想把这种现状正式化。

sentences.en: And is this a thing?
sentences.zh: 这可行吗？

sentences.en: I mean, have countries done this before?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，以前有国家这样做过吗？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: There are more than 30 countries that have actually adopted another nation's currency as their own legal tender.
sentences.zh: 有 30 多个国家实际上已经采用其他国家的货币作为自己的法定货币。

sentences.en: And in Latin America, specifically, there have been a few cases of dollarization.
sentences.zh: 特别是在拉丁美洲，已经有几个美元化的案例。

sentences.en: Panama is dollarized, Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 巴拿马是美元化的，还有厄瓜多尔。

sentences.en: And so, this is not a completely novel idea, but Argentina is a larger and more sophisticated economy than those other nations.
sentences.zh: 所以，这并不是一个完全新颖的想法，但阿根廷是一个比那些国家更大、更复杂的经济体。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So, dollarization has been done, though, in smaller Latin American countries.
sentences.zh: 不过，拉丁美洲一些较小的国家已经实行过美元化了。

sentences.en: But what are the mechanics of it?
sentences.zh: 但其运作机制是怎样的呢？

sentences.en: How does it work?
sentences.zh: 它是如何运作的？

sentences.en: So, how to do it is relatively simple, in theory.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，实施方法相对简单。

sentences.en: First, the country must agree upon an exchange rate for its currency to the dollar.
sentences.zh: 首先，该国必须就本国货币兑美元的汇率达成一致。

sentences.en: And then, the country, on a specified date, essentially flips the switch.
sentences.zh: 然后，在指定的日期，该国基本上就像按下了开关一样。

sentences.en: And all of its obligations, things like contracts and deposits and loans and wages, are all converted to dollars on paper at that agreed-upon rate.
sentences.zh: 所有的债务，比如合同、存款、贷款和工资，在纸面上都会按照约定的汇率转换为美元。

sentences.en: And then, there is another part, which is potentially more tricky, particularly for Argentina.
sentences.zh: 接下来还有另一个环节，这可能更棘手，尤其是对阿根廷而言。

sentences.en: And that is converting all of Argentine's pesos, the physical banknotes, to physical U.S.
sentences.zh: 那就是将所有阿根廷比索，即实物纸币，转换为实物美元。

sentences.en: dollars.
sentences.zh: 美元。

sentences.en: And for that, you need dollars.
sentences.zh: 为此，你需要美元。

sentences.en: So, mainstream economists believe that the government may need up to $30 to $40 billion to dollarize.
sentences.zh: 主流经济学家认为，政府可能需要300亿到400亿美元才能实现美元化。

sentences.en: And that could be a big problem for Millet and his plans.
sentences.zh: 这对米莱及其计划来说可能是一个大问题。

sentences.en: So, Argentines, like Oscar, the hardware store owner, they might have a lot of dollars.
sentences.zh: 所以，像五金店老板奥斯卡这样的阿根廷人，他们可能有很多美元。

sentences.en: But what you're saying is that the government itself does not.
sentences.zh: 但你的意思是政府本身没有。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And one risk is that if the government doesn't have enough dollars, it may not give Argentines much confidence in a dollarization scheme.
sentences.zh: 一个风险是，如果政府没有足够的美元，可能无法让阿根廷人对美元化计划产生信心。

sentences.en: So, for instance, if you're an Argentine and you see in your bank account that the government has now suddenly converted your pesos to dollars,
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你是一个阿根廷人，看到银行账户里的比索突然被政府换成了美元，

sentences.en: but you're skeptical that the government actually has enough dollars for everyone, maybe you're going to go to the bank and take that money out before your neighbor does.
sentences.zh: 但你怀疑政府是否真的有足够的美元支付给所有人，那你可能会在邻居行动之前去银行把钱取出来。

sentences.en: And if the next person does that, and then the next person does that, now we have a run on the banks.
sentences.zh: 如果下一个人也这么做，再下一个人也这么做，那就会引发银行挤兑。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, a lot of hurdles here.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里有很多障碍。

sentences.en: I mean, they need dollars to dollarize.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要美元才能进行美元化。

sentences.en: They don't have them.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有。

sentences.en: And then there's a chance that when people see what's happening, they panic, they race to the banks, and they take their money out, causing a real crisis in the financial system.
sentences.zh: 而且一旦人们看到这种情况，他们可能会恐慌，争先恐后地去银行取钱，从而导致金融体系出现真正的危机。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, there are some real hurdles and some real risks.
sentences.zh: 所以，确实存在一些真正的障碍和风险。

sentences.en: But there is also a competing view that there could be real benefits.
sentences.zh: 但也有另一种观点认为，这可能会带来真正的好处。

sentences.en: We have seen dollarization really almost eliminate inflation in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我们曾见过美元化在过去几乎消除了通货膨胀。

sentences.en: And on top of that, in a place like Argentina, where there is $200 billion in U.S.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，在阿根廷这样的地方，有2000亿美元的现金被塞在床垫下和保险箱里，

sentences.en: currencies stuffed under mattresses and in safe deposit boxes, dollarization could bring those dollars from under mattresses and into banks officially.
sentences.zh: 美元化可以将这些藏在床垫下的美元正式带入银行系统。

sentences.en: And that could be a real benefit for the economy.
sentences.zh: 这对经济来说可能是一个真正的好处。

sentences.en: So, there's a real question about whether his signature policy, you know, this dollarization, would actually work even if he could pull it off.
sentences.zh: 所以，即便他能成功实施，他的标志性政策——也就是美元化——是否真的有效，确实是一个大问题。

sentences.en: But I guess the question in my mind, you know, since he's now, of course, in office as of today, is can he pull it off?
sentences.zh: 但我心里想的问题是，既然他今天已经正式上任了，他能成功吗？

sentences.en: Like, you know, he has these ideas that were electric for people in Argentina, for voters, but can he implement them?
sentences.zh: 他提出的这些想法对阿根廷民众和选民来说非常振奋人心，但他能落实吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think that's another major hurdle to his plan for dollarization.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这是他美元化计划的另一个主要障碍。

sentences.en: Because, remember, Millet is a total political outsider.
sentences.zh: 因为要记住，米莱完全是一个政治局外人。

sentences.en: He's coming in with no governing experience.
sentences.zh: 他没有任何执政经验。

sentences.en: And his nascent political party, just two years old, has just 15% of the seats in the House.
sentences.zh: 他那刚成立两年的新兴政党在众议院仅拥有15%的席位。

sentences.en: And something like dollarization would need congressional approval.
sentences.zh: 而像美元化这样的事情需要国会批准。

sentences.en: So, what we've seen since the election is actually a bit of dealmaking.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们自选举以来看到的是一些交易行为。

sentences.en: He has actually started to make deals with a center-right coalition, which would give him potential control of Congress.
sentences.zh: 他实际上已经开始与中右翼联盟进行交易，这可能会让他获得对国会的控制权。

sentences.en: But as a result, he has brought in more moderate members into his cabinet.
sentences.zh: 但结果就是，他不得不将更多温和派成员引入内阁。

sentences.en: And his focus in recent weeks has really shifted from things like dollarization to more about his plans to shrink the size of government and budget cuts.
sentences.zh: 最近几周，他的重心已经从美元化转向了缩减政府规模和削减预算的计划。

sentences.en: And I think what we're seeing is Millet is confronting the political and economic reality as president of Argentina.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们看到的是，米莱作为阿根廷总统正在面对政治和经济现实。

sentences.en: And dollarization may be something he does down the road.
sentences.zh: 美元化可能只是他未来才会做的事情。

sentences.en: So, this is a case where Millet campaigns as an outsider with these radical plans, but the political realities force him to moderate those plans once he's in office.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个米莱以局外人身份竞选并提出激进计划，但上任后政治现实迫使他缓和这些计划的案例。

sentences.en: Well, I think we should remember that what Millet is proposing for right now for Argentina is actually rather radical, particularly when considering Argentina's history.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们应该记住，米莱目前为阿根廷提出的方案实际上相当激进，尤其是考虑到阿根廷的历史。

sentences.en: These would be very, very deep government budget cuts.
sentences.zh: 这将是非常、非常深度的政府预算削减。

sentences.en: And this is a country where many people have come to rely upon government services and subsidies.
sentences.zh: 而在这个国家，许多人已经习惯了依赖政府的服务和补贴。

sentences.en: And so, these policies could be really difficult.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些政策可能会非常困难。

sentences.en: And remember, this is a country that is already struggling with a deep economic crisis.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，这个国家本身就已经深陷严重的经济危机之中。

sentences.en: So, poverty is already up, hunger is already up, and that could get worse.
sentences.zh: 贫困率已经在上升，饥饿问题也在加剧，情况可能会变得更糟。

sentences.en: And Millet has actually warned the next year is going to be very tough.
sentences.zh: 米莱实际上已经警告说，明年将会非常艰难。

sentences.en: But on the other side, this is actually what some economists think Argentina should have been doing a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，这实际上是一些经济学家认为阿根廷早就应该做的事情。

sentences.en: You know, they actually need some of this hard medicine.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们确实需要这种“苦口良药”。

sentences.en: But we don't know how it's going to play out in reality.
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道现实中会如何发展。

sentences.en: So, in other words, the Hail Mary that Argentines went for in this election, it may in fact be the medicine that the ailing economy needs.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，阿根廷人在这次选举中孤注一掷的选择，可能确实是这个病态经济体所需要的药方。

sentences.en: But the application of that medicine, it's going to be very difficult to swallow.
sentences.zh: 但要服下这剂药，过程将会非常痛苦。

sentences.en: Have Argentines considered that the cure could feel as bad as the disease?
sentences.zh: 阿根廷人是否考虑过，治疗过程可能会和疾病本身一样痛苦？

sentences.en: I think that's a major risk.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个巨大的风险。

sentences.en: Millet is a radically libertarian president who has an avowed hatred for the government, who is now in charge of what has, for many years, been a very big government.
sentences.zh: 米莱是一位激进的自由意志主义总统，他公开厌恶政府，而现在他负责管理一个多年来一直非常庞大的政府。

sentences.en: And he's made clear that starting this week, his plans to shrink that government will be really painful for the country.
sentences.zh: 他已经明确表示，从本周开始，他缩减政府的计划对国家来说将是非常痛苦的。

sentences.en: And so that means that a populace that's already suffering so much economically is now being told that they're going to have to suffer a lot more before it gets any better.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，一个在经济上已经饱受苦难的民众，现在被告知在情况好转之前，他们还得承受更多的痛苦。

sentences.en: So, the question is, will Argentines put up with that?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，阿根廷人能忍受吗？

sentences.en: And whether or not they do may decide, after so many years of struggle,
sentences.zh: 他们是否能忍受，可能决定了在经历了这么多年的挣扎之后，

sentences.en: whether Argentina can finally right its course.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷能否最终纠正航向。

sentences.en: Jack, thank you.
sentences.zh: 杰克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Sunday, after being sworn into office,
sentences.zh: 周日，在宣誓就职后，

sentences.en: President Millet addressed thousands of his supporters in the Argentine capital of Buenos Aires.
sentences.zh: 米莱总统在阿根廷首都布宜诺斯艾利斯向成千上万的支持者发表了讲话。

sentences.en: In the speech, Millet laid the responsibility for the country's economic problems at the feet of the outgoing administration and promised to take the, quote,
sentences.zh: 在演讲中，米莱将国家经济问题的责任归咎于即将离任的政府，并承诺采取所谓的

sentences.en: necessary decisions to solve them.
sentences.zh: “必要的决定”来解决这些问题。

sentences.en: Soon after, in his first official decree, the new president cut the number of government ministries from 18 to 9.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，在新总统的第一份正式法令中，他将政府部门的数量从18个削减到了9个。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wenna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘文娜（Wenna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called chromesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Here's what else to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, prominent Democrats moved to denounce anti-Semitism in the wake of a growing scandal that saw the president of the University of Pennsylvania
sentences.zh: 周末，在宾夕法尼亚大学校长因上周在国会作证后辞职的丑闻不断发酵之际，杰出的民主党人采取行动谴责反犹太主义。

sentences.en: resign after giving testimony to Congress last week.
sentences.zh: 辞职。

sentences.en: We shouldn't have to gather on a rainy day in Pennsylvania to talk about anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 我们本不应该在宾夕法尼亚州一个下雨的日子聚集在一起谈论反犹太主义。

sentences.en: But we muSt.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须这样做。

sentences.en: Appearing at a synagogue in Philadelphia,
sentences.zh: 在费城的一座犹太教堂露面时，

sentences.en: Senator Bob Casey of Pennsylvania and the state's governor, Josh Shapiro, made the show of solidarity just one day after the resignation
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州参议员鲍勃·凯西（Bob Casey）和该州州长乔什·夏皮罗（Josh Shapiro）在大学校长伊丽莎白·麦吉尔（Elizabeth McGill）辞职后的第二天，表达了团结一致的姿态。

sentences.en: of the university president, Elizabeth McGill.
sentences.zh: 辞职。

sentences.en: McGill's departure followed days of pressure from donors, political leaders, and alumni who had criticized remarks she made to Congress that appeared to evade the question
sentences.zh: 麦吉尔的离职是在捐赠者、政治领袖和校友持续数日的压力下发生的，他们批评她在国会发表的言论似乎在回避一个问题：

sentences.en: of whether students who called for the genocide of Jews should be punished.
sentences.zh: 即呼吁对犹太人进行种族灭绝的学生是否应该受到惩罚。

sentences.en: The presidents of Harvard and MIT made similar remarks to Congress last week and are now also under pressure to resign.
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学和麻省理工学院的校长上周在国会也发表了类似的言论，目前也面临辞职压力。

sentences.en: And European Union policymakers agreed late last week to a sweeping new law to regulate artificial intelligence, one of the world's first comprehensive attempts
sentences.zh: 欧盟政策制定者上周晚些时候就一项旨在监管人工智能的全面新法律达成一致，这是世界上首次尝试全面限制这种快速发展的技术的使用。

sentences.en: to limit the use of a rapidly evolving technology.
sentences.zh: 限制使用。

sentences.en: The law, called the AI Act, sets a benchmark for countries seeking to harness the potential benefits of the technology while trying to protect against the possible risks,
sentences.zh: 这项名为《人工智能法案》的法律为那些寻求利用该技术潜在利益，同时试图防范可能风险的国家设定了基准，

sentences.en: like automating jobs, spreading misinformation online, and endangering national security.
sentences.zh: 比如工作自动化、在线传播虚假信息以及危害国家安全。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Carlos Prieto,
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卡洛斯·普列托（Carlos Prieto）制作，

sentences.en: Rochelle Bonja, and Stella Tan.
sentences.zh: 罗谢尔·邦贾（Rochelle Bonja）和斯特拉·谭（Stella Tan）共同制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by MJ Davis-Lynn and Mark George, fact-checked by Susan Lee, contains original music by Marian Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由MJ·戴维斯-林恩（MJ Davis-Lynn）和马克·乔治（Mark George）编辑，苏珊·李（Susan Lee）核实事实，包含玛丽安·洛萨诺（Marian Lozano）和丹·鲍威尔（Dan Powell）的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德（Chris Wood）进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格（Jim Brunberg）和本·兰斯福德（Ben Lansford）创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《The Daily》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西（Sabrina Tavernisi）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《The Wirecutter Show》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或任何你喜欢收听的地方找到《The Wirecutter Show》。
